gen.refuse.ip: We can't make art that copies existing characters, brands, logos or someone else's work, because it could cause copyright problems. Try describing shapes and colors instead, like "a wall piece with soft yellow stars."
gen.refuse.note: This request didn't count toward today's limit.
gen.refuse.people: We can't make pictures of real people or celebrities. Try a scene or pattern instead, like "a window view with the moon between clouds."
gen.refuse.personal: We can't make pictures with phone numbers, addresses, links, QR codes or lots of text. You can add short text to the room separately.
gen.refuse.photo: We can't make realistic, photo-like images. Describe something soft and hand-drawn, like Aroomi's world.

gen.refuse.unsafe: We can't make anything sexual, violent, hateful or harmful. Try describing something cozy instead.
